name: java-analyzer
description: Java language support through the java-analyzer language server

java-analyzer.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `java-analyzer` executable. Empty: look it up on `PATH`. Changing it restarts the server.

java-analyzer.server.extraEnv.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the server and the debug adapter, e.g. `{ "JA_LOG": "info" }` (the server log goes to the output channel). Changing it restarts the server.

java-analyzer.trace.server.description: Trace the LSP messages between VS Code and the server.

java-analyzer.jdkHome.markdownDescription: JDK installation directory. Unset: `JAVA_HOME`, `/usr/libexec/java_home`, SDKMAN, `~/.jdks`, Gradle toolchains, mise / asdf, in that order. Changing it re-imports the project.

java-analyzer.maven.useCli.markdownDescription: Run `mvn` (`./mvnw` first) to download artifacts missing from the local repository (modules of a multi-module project do not need to be installed first); modules still unresolved after that get their class path from `mvn`.

java-analyzer.maven.localRepository.markdownDescription: Directory of the Maven local repository. When unset it is found like Maven does: `-Dmaven.repo.local` in `MAVEN_OPTS`, `<localRepository>` in the settings file (`java-analyzer.maven.settings`, else `~/.m2/settings.xml`), then in the Maven installation's `conf/settings.xml`, else `~/.m2/repository`. Passed to `mvn` as `-Dmaven.repo.local`. Changing it re-imports the project.

java-analyzer.maven.settings.markdownDescription: Maven settings file used instead of `~/.m2/settings.xml`, like `mvn -s`: its `<localRepository>` and mirrors are used, and it is passed to `mvn` with `-s`. Changing it re-imports the project.

java-analyzer.gradle.enabled.description: Allow running Gradle to import the project. When off, only the cached result of the last import is used.

java-analyzer.completion.autoImport.description: Add an import when completing a type that is not imported yet; when off, insert the fully qualified name.

java-analyzer.completion.unimportedTypes.description: Include types that are not imported yet in completion.

java-analyzer.completion.limit.description: Maximum number of completion items returned at once.

java-analyzer.codeLens.implementations.description: Show implementation counts above types and methods.

java-analyzer.codeLens.command.markdownDescription: Command run when clicking a code lens, called with `[uri, position, locations]`. Unset: a peek view listing the references / implementations.

java-analyzer.newFileTemplate.markdownDescription: Fill a newly created empty `.java` file with its package declaration and a class of the same name.

java-analyzer.downloadSources.description: Download the sources jar in the background when navigating into a library class that has no sources.

java-analyzer.decompiler.description: Decompile method bodies into the stub opened for a library class without sources; when off, the stub has signatures only.

java-analyzer.diagnostics.semantic.description: Report semantic diagnostics (unresolved symbols, type mismatches, ...); when off, only syntax errors.

java-analyzer.diagnostics.unusedSymbols.description: Report unused local variables and private members.

java-analyzer.diagnostics.workspace.description: Compute diagnostics for the whole project (errors and warnings, for the Problems view). Unset: only when the project has at most 3000 source files.

mainClass.markdownDescription: Fully qualified name of the main class; `module/MainClass` launches it as a module (`-m`).

projectRoot.description: Project root, used to import the project model and find sources. Defaults to cwd.

cwd.description: Working directory of the JVM. Defaults to projectRoot.

classPaths.description: Class path. Computed from the project model when omitted.

env.description: Environment variables; null removes a variable.

javaExec.markdownDescription: The `java` executable. Defaults to the project's JDK or `JAVA_HOME`.

sourcePaths.description: Additional source directories for stack frames.

jdkHome.markdownDescription: JDK used to import the project and launch the program. Defaults to the `java-analyzer.jdkHome` setting; `[jdk]` in `java-analyzer.toml` takes precedence.

mavenSettings.markdownDescription: Maven settings file used instead of `~/.m2/settings.xml`. Defaults to the `java-analyzer.maven.settings` setting; `[maven]` in `java-analyzer.toml` takes precedence.

mavenLocalRepository.markdownDescription: Maven local repository directory. Defaults to the `java-analyzer.maven.localRepository` setting; `[maven]` in `java-analyzer.toml` takes precedence.

projectRoot.description: Project root, used to find sources.

jdkHome.markdownDescription: JDK whose sources are shown for JDK classes. Defaults to the `java-analyzer.jdkHome` setting; `[jdk]` in `java-analyzer.toml` takes precedence.

mavenSettings.markdownDescription: Maven settings file used instead of `~/.m2/settings.xml` when locating sources jars. Defaults to the `java-analyzer.maven.settings` setting; `[maven]` in `java-analyzer.toml` takes precedence.

mavenLocalRepository.markdownDescription: Maven local repository directory used when locating sources jars. Defaults to the `java-analyzer.maven.localRepository` setting; `[maven]` in `java-analyzer.toml` takes precedence.
